Definition: of Hebrew origin (H410 and H1935); God of majesty; Eliud, an Israelite:--Eliud.
BiblicalUsage: Eliud is an Israelite. In Matthew 1:14, the text says "and Achim begat Eliud."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, elioúd means Eliud, nothing more and nothing less.
